params.name: Leviathan 2076
params.note: CONCEPT, generated by scripts/shapes/concepts/leviathan-2076.mjs (edit that, not this). The Leviathan fifty years on, after JetZero's blended wing body and Radia's WindRunner: one lifting body as wide as the hold, thinning into swept outer wings with raked winglets; four hydrogen turbofans on pylons over the upper aft deck between two canted fins with boil-off masts on their tips; elevons across the trailing edge; a glazed flight deck cab proud on the nose; the centipede gear in two sponsons. The cargo visor is kept: the nose and the cab swing up on the noseVisor channel by the fw_heavy row's angle, and the hold and its ramp exist only while it is open. A variant of the heavy mesh, worn as the Leviathan 2076 factory edition.

parts.name: fuselage
parts.note: The centrebody aft of the visor joint: the hold, the hydrogen tanks, the engine deck. Detail is laid a hair proud of it.
